title: ttsopensource language registry entry
description: One entry per language. STT / translation / TTS capability are tracked independently — a language can have STT yes, translation yes, TTS limited, all at once. Both gpu-service (Python) and orchestrator (Node) load this same file so there is exactly one source of truth.

language_code.description: ISO 639-1 (or 639-3 for languages without a 639-1 code), e.g. 'es', 'yo'.

whisper_code.description: Code passed to whisper/faster-whisper, or null if not in its language list.

stt_fallback.description: Engine name to try when whisper_code is null, e.g. 'mms-asr'.

tts_model.description: HF repo id or Piper voice filename.

status.description: Computed UI-facing status. 'available' = all stages solid; 'limited' = works but lower quality; 'experimental' = unverified checkpoint or missing STT; 'unsupported' = a required stage has no model at all.

enabled.description: Whether this language is exposed to viewers right now. Can be false even when status != unsupported, pending manual verification.

priority.description: Rollout tier: 1 = initial ~20 languages, 2 = next ~45, 3 = long tail (500-1000 language expansion).
